leadersOnly: Only band leaders and admins can upload recordings.
audioOnly: Only audio files are supported (mp3, m4a, wav, aac, ogg, webm, flac, aiff)
fileTooLarge: File too large. Maximum size is {maxMb}MB
songNotFound: That song isn't in this library.
uploadNotFound: That upload wasn't found. Upload the file again.
uploadMissing: The file didn't finish uploading. Try again.
uploadMismatch: The file arrived incomplete. Try again.
tooManyPending: You have several uploads still in progress. Wait for them to finish, then try again.
